title: EasyBoost
description: A lightweight performance and QOL modpack
body:
![EasyBoost - Ultimate Performance](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2839d9af2dbf22ebb1336d80577e409ce23d6f95.png) Want a fully barebones version? Check out [EasyBoost Lite](https://modrinth.com/modpack/easyboost-lite)
# EasyBoost Overview **EasyBoost** is a lightweight, optimised, Fabric-based modpack designed to enhance and improve your Minecraft Experience both in singleplayer and multiplayer, all whilst providing a stable framerate # Features ✅ **Optimised Performance** - Smooth inputs and stable framerates
✅ **Enhanced Visuals** - Connected Textures, Incredible Shaders, and Model Updates
✅ **Broad Compatibility** – Supports Minecraft 1.21+ and works with almost all modpack-supported launchers

Always use the latest version of **EasyBoost** for the best performance # Mod List
List of mods used in this modpack ``` BadOptimizations Cloth Config API Concurent Chunk Management Engine Continuity Debugify Entity Culling Fabric API Fabric Language Kotlin Ferrite Core Gamma Utils GPUBooster Immediatly Fast Iris Shaders Force Close Loading Screen Krypton Language Reload Lithium Midnight Lib Mod Menu More Culling Mouse Tweaks OptiGUI Packet Fixer Puzzle Reese's Sodium Options Resourcify Sodium Sodium Extra Spark Text Placeholder API Toadlib Very Many Players YetAnotherConfigLib Zoomify ```
